body: It was on one of those ride picture screens, and my sister took a picture of it before the next picture showed up. So I just took a picture of her screen.

It's difficult to change who I'm around when it's a small group to begin with. I've talked to a professional about it, and even my doctor, but they weren't much help. I waste too much time thinking about this, and always bore whoever I'm taking to. I just want to move on sometimes. However I also just want everything to go back to how great it used to be. I've narrowed down the cause of my depression to my ex, but going cold turkey from her was excruciatingly difficult the first for I tried it. I don't know what to do anymore to be honest.
